decisions.decision: Incorporate all 7 ship-blocker fixes from /autoplan review into implementation
decisions.rationale: CodeExecutor RCE, SSE polling, condition routing, recordNode duplicates, no auth, no error handling, Promise.all were all critical

decisions.decision: Use EventEmitter for SSE instead of DB polling
decisions.rationale: DB polling at 500ms per client doesn't scale past single-user
new Function() gave access to process.env which would leak API keys

decisions.decision: Use native HTML select instead of Radix/shadcn Select
decisions.rationale: Avoids complex dependency; simple styled select works for MVP

decisions.decision: Support HTML5 drag from NodePalette AND click-to-add fallback
decisions.rationale: Design review flagged click-only as not meeting 'drag-and-drop' promise

next_action: Start PostgreSQL, run pnpm db:push, then pnpm dev. Open http://localhost:5173 and test the full workflow: create workflow, add nodes, connect them, configure properties, save, run with debug panel.
context_notes: Full /autoplan review completed (CEO + Design + Eng + DX). All phases implemented with review fixes. 19 tests passing, frontend builds clean. The product needs a running PostgreSQL instance and API keys to fully function.
